title: Guttmann-Flury et al. 2025 — Eye-BCI P300 dataset
description: A multimodal P300 speller dataset combining EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video recordings from 31 healthy participants across 3 sessions each. The dataset comprises 2,520 trials from a row-column visual speller paradigm with 64-channel EEG recordings at 1000 Hz sampling rate, designed to support brain-computer interface research and ocular activity analysis.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Neuroscan Quik-Cap 65-channel system with SynAmps2 amplifier at 1000 Hz sampling rate. Sixty-four EEG channels were recorded using Ag/AgCl sensors in the standard 1005 montage, referenced to the right mastoid (M1) with ground at the forehead. Additional channels included 1 EOG and 1 stimulus channel. Online high-pass filtering was applied with a 10-second time constant. Participants completed a row-column P300 speller task with 4L and 5L grid sizes in a laboratory setting.
